summary: Fade a 4h sized thrust that breaks the prior high or prior low then closes back inside that prior bar (SHORT = failed upside thrust, LONG = failed downside thrust) as one 4h BOTH family with SHORT priority.
justification: A locked ATR20 same-bar high/low break of the immediate prior bar, sized by min_thrust_atr, then close back inside that prior bar, is not a rolling Donchian fail, not an NR7 / London-IB / ORB fail, not an outside-bar both-rail next-bar mid-split, not family-F IB-mother wick-fail, not expansion TR+weak-vol, and not a hammer reject or VP cluster.
